market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain volatile with Iran conflict as swing factor. Oil likely range-bound if strikes stay short per Trump. Bond yields may consolidate near highs, supporting equities (Shah's 'no discomfort' view). Yen remains a wildcard—intervention talk keeps FX jumpy. Asian markets vulnerable to further oil/yield spikes. Expect choppy 1-3 month window with geopolitical headlines driving 2-3% daily swings.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favor AI infrastructure (power, chips, data centers), energy transition (Saudi nuclear, Fervo), and gold/central bank diversification. Bond yields likely remain elevated 6-12 months given inflation persistence from energy. EM credit bifurcation continues. European energy vulnerability is a multi-year overhang. AI capex cycle enters maturation phase with greater dispersion among winners/losers.
